title: riglab.part v1
description: One pixel-art part as a grid of palette keys (src/format/part.ts, validatePart), placed on its bone by the top-left pixel. Each pixel is a 2 x 2 cell in rig units; `.` draws nothing. Rules this schema cannot express, which a reader must check itself: there are exactly `size[1]` rows and each is exactly `size[0]` characters; every row character is `.` or a key of `keys`; every key is used at least once, so the part draws at least one pixel; a key's class tokens are distinct. Class tokens refer to the set's `riglab.palette` classes.

origin.description: The top-left pixel's position in the bone's frame, in pixels.

rows.description: One string per pixel row, top to bottom.

keys.description: Each row character's class tokens in the palette's cascade order, separated by single spaces.

name.description: 1-64 letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter.
